title: Telehealth Billing Documentation
content: Telehealth Billing Documentation. Telehealth billing records should contain the service date, service type, provider information, billing amount, and relevant insurance information. Missing required billing information should be corrected before final submission.

title: Payment Reconciliation Guidance
content: Payment Reconciliation Guidance. Payment reconciliation compares the invoiced amount, insurance-approved amount, and payment received. Differences between the approved amount and payment received should be reviewed before closing the transaction.

title: Telehealth Consent Documentation
content: Telehealth Consent Documentation. Telehealth workflows should maintain appropriate documentation of patient consent according to applicable organizational policies and requirements.

title: Missing Insurance Information
content: Missing Insurance Information. If an insurance identifier is missing from a billing transaction, the transaction should be reviewed and the missing information should be obtained before final billing.

title: Billing Error Review
content: Billing Error Review. Potential billing errors should be reviewed using the available evidence. The system should not assume missing information or label a transaction fraudulent without sufficient evidence.
